blurb.kids: Ten questions — the Bible, Jesus, and our own church.
blurb.teens: Ten questions on the Bible, Jesus and FLCC. No clues, no second guesses.

blurb.kids: Three clues. One person from the Bible.
blurb.teens: Three clues, hardest first. Guess early for more points.

blurb.kids: Fill the squares. Every word is a Bible word.
blurb.teens: Eight answers, one grid, no letters given away.

blurb.kids: Put the words back in the right order.
blurb.teens: Rebuild the verse from its pieces, against the clock if you want.
Sixty seconds. As many as you can.

blurb.kids: Ten questions about FLCC — who we are and what we believe.
blurb.teens: FLCC, the BOTR network, and what this church actually holds to.

blurb.kids: Fly your ship and blast the bugs! Touch the sky and drag to fly anywhere — it fires by itself. Every new wave gives you a power-up!
blurb.teens: The arcade classic. It never ends, and every wave is harder than the last. Drag on the field to fly anywhere and fire. Each new wave hands you a power: shield, rapid fire, triple shot or speed.

blurb.kids: Help the chicken cross the roads, ride the logs and dodge the trains! Tap to hop.
blurb.teens: Roads, rivers, trains and a mist at your back. It never ends — how far can you get?

blurb.kids: Swipe up to shoot the ball through the moving hoop! Make enough baskets to win each level.
blurb.teens: Swipe to shoot at sliding hoops. Every level is harder — faster rims, wind, a defender — and every one can be beaten.

blurb.kids: Move the claw, press DROP and grab a toy — a teddy, a dino, a robot! Win enough toys to beat each level.
blurb.teens: A toy machine that isn't rigged: a centred grab always holds. 25 levels of conveyors, a swinging claw, a slippery grip, a sliding prize box and toys too heavy to lift.

blurb.kids: Papa monkey is locked in a cage! Climb the vines, dodge the lizards and birds, and bring him the key.
blurb.teens: Two vines climb fast, one slides fast. Knock fruit onto the lizards, dodge birds and coconuts — 25 levels to free papa.
